label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: Nothing that is being moved in a respect moves itself…
locator: I q.2 a.3 co., prima via: Impossibile est ergo quod, secundum idem et eodem modo, aliquid sit movens et motum
interpretation: The intermediate conclusion (ergo) from the act and potency premises. It excludes self-motion only secundum idem et eodem modo; a whole whose part moves another part in a different respect is not excluded, matching Aristotle's treatment of self-movers in Physics VII.1 and VIII.5.
